title: Implement Word Break DP in Python
description: Implement word_break(s, word_dict) using bottom-up DP: return True if s can be segmented into words from word_dict, False otherwise.

files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "word_break"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = []

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["."]

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]

task_spec.prompt:
Implement word_break in src/word_break.py:
- Convert word_dict to a set for O(1) lookup
- Create dp[0..n] initialized to False; set dp[0]=True (empty prefix always reachable)
- For i in 1..n: for j in 0..i: if dp[j] is True and s[j:i] is in word_set, set dp[i]=True and break
- Return dp[n]
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
